note: SHA-1-Digest manifest; assets/patch.bin (hex token) appended after signing, so it is absent from MANIFEST.MF
generator_cmd: python3 -c 'import zipfile ...' (zipfile.writestr of AndroidManifest.xml / classes.dex stubs + assets) ; keytool -genkeypair -keystore ks.jks -keyalg RSA -dname 'CN=Tamper Test, O=Huntress' ; jarsigner -digestalg SHA-1 -sigalg SHA256withRSA t2.apk k ; python3 -c 'zipfile.ZipFile(apk,"a").writestr("assets/patch.bin", b"ANS-C0FFEE1234ABCD99".hex())'
oracle_cmd: jarsigner -verify -verbose v1tamper_unlisted_sha1.apk (assets/patch.bin is the only entry without the 'm' in-manifest flag) ; unzip -p v1tamper_unlisted_sha1.apk assets/patch.bin | xxd -r -p
